## New
- Heer Music brings Heer Labs branding, a new logo and an independent project home.
- Smart Downloads can use a GB budget with estimated song counts and listening hours.
- Song and Video controls use the existing music-video playback path when a match is available.

## Improved
- Like queues a song for offline listening; Dislike removes its downloaded audio and improves recommendations.
- Download status identifies network, charging, battery and storage constraints.
- Smart Downloads has a direct Home toolbar entry and checks the final file size against the storage budget.
